integrity_note: The analytic proof covers all integers k,h>=1. Finite matrix verification is supplementary. Primary full text of the motivating preprint was not accessible; equivalence risk remains. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only coordinate-face boundary data, unweighted hypercube graph Laplacians, and counting-ell2 norms are covered. Constant mode amplifies by 2^h. No claim of minimal embedding or partial-sampling robustness.
title: A sharp universal mean-zero stability constant for harmonic completion from cubical faces
